title_zh: 亞斯納 第 48 章‧伽薩‧真理勝虛妄
orig_source: avesta.org，蓋爾德納校本轉寫（舊式羅馬轉寫）
en_source: 《東方聖書》第 31 卷，1887；公有領域
licence: 原文轉寫與英譯均取自 avesta.org（Joseph H. Peterson 編）；英譯為《東方聖書》舊譯，已入公有領域。繁中為本站自譯。

segments.orig:
ýezî adâish ashâ drujem vêñnghaitî
hyat ãsashutâ ýâ daibitânâ
fraoxtâ ameretâitî daêvâishcâ
mashyâishcâ at tôi savâish vahmem vaxshat
ahurâ.
segments.en:
When at the Recompensings the Right shall smite the Liar,
so that what was long since made known shall be assigned to eternity
to Daevas and men, then will it exalt with thy blessings, Ahura,
him who prays to thee.

segments.orig:
vaocâ-môi ýâ tvêm vîdvå
ahurâ parâ hyat mâ ýâ mêñg
perethâ jimaitî kat ashavâ mazdâ vêñghat
dregvañtem hâ-zî anghêush vanguhî
vistâ âkeretish.
segments.en:
Tell me, for thou art he that knows, O Ahura: - shall the
Righteous smite the Liar before the retributions come which thou
hast conceived? That were indeed a message to bless the world.

segments.orig:
at vaêdemnâi vahishtâ sâsnanãm
ýãm hudå sâstî ashâ ahurô
dà speñtô vîdvå ýaêcît
gûzrâ sêñghånghô thwâvãs
mazdâ vanghêush xrathwâ mananghô.
segments.en:
For him that knows, that is the best of teachings which the
beneficent Ahura teaches through the Right, he the holy one, even
thyself, O Mazda, that knows the secret lore through the wisdom
of Good Thought.

segments.orig:
ýê dât manô vahyô mazdâ
ashyascâ hvô daênãm shyaothanâcâ
vacanghâcâ ahyâ zaoshêñg ushtish
varenêñg hacaitê thwahmî xratå
apêmem nanâ anghat.
segments.en:
Whoso, O Mazda, makes his thought (now) better, (now) worse,
and likewise his Self by action and by word, and follows his own
inclinations, wishes, and choices, he shall in thy purpose be
in a separate place at last.

segments.orig:
huxshathrâ xshêñtãm mâ-nê
dushe-xshathrâ xshêñtâ vanghuyå
cistôish shyaothanâish ârmaitê ýaozhdå
mashyâi aipî zãthem vahishtâ gavôi
verezyâtãm tãm nê hvarethâi fshuyô.
segments.en:
Let good rulers rule us, not evil rulers with the actions
of the Good Lore, O Piety! Perfect thou for man, O thou most good,
the future birth, and for the cow skilled husbandry. Let her grow
fat for our nourishing.

segments.orig:
hâ-zî-nê hushôithemâ hâ-nê
utayûitîm dât tevîshîm vanghêush
mananghô berexdhê at ah'yâi ashâ mazdå
urvarå vaxshat ahurô anghêush zãthôi
paouruyehyâ.
segments.en:
She (Armaiti) will give us peaceful dwelling, she will give
lasting life and strength, she the beloved of Good Thought. For
it (the cattle) Mazda Ahura made the plants to grow at the birth
of the First Life, through Right.

segments.orig:
nî aêshemô nî dyâtãm
paitî remem paitî syôzdûm ýôi
â vanghêush mananghô dîdrakhzhôduyê
ashâ vyãm ýehyâ hithâush nâ
speñtô at hôi dâmãm thwahmî
â-dãm ahurâ.
segments.en:
Violence must be put down! against cruelty make a stand, ye
who would make sure of the reward of Good Thought through Right,
to whose company the holy man belongs. His dwelling place shall
be in thy House, O Ahura.

segments.orig:
kâ-tôi vanghêush mazdâ xshathrahyâ
îshtish kâ-tôi ashôish thwah'yå
maibyô ahurâ kâ-thwôi ashâ âkå
aredrêñg ishyâ vanghêush manyêush
shyaothananãm javarô.
segments.en:
Is the possession of thy good Dominion, Mazda, is that of
thy Destiny assured to me Ahura? Will thy manifestation, O thou
Right, be welcome to the pious, even the weighing of actions by
the Good Spirit [Spenta Mainyu -JHP]?

segments.orig:
kadâ vaêdâ ýezî cahyâ
xshayathâ mazdâ ashâ ýehyâ-mâ
âithish dvaêthâ eresh-môi erezhûcãm
vanghêush vafush mananghô vîdyât saoshyãs
ýathâ hôi ashish anghat.
segments.en:
When shall I know whether ye have power, O Mazda and Right,
over everyone whose destructiveness is a menace to me? Let the
revelation of Good Thought be confirmed unto me; the future deliverer
should know how his own destiny shall be.

segments.orig:
kadâ mazdâ mãnarôish narô vîseñtê
kadâ ajên mûthrem ahyâ magahyâ ýâ
añgrayâ karapanô urûpayeiñtî
ýâcâ xratû dushe-xshathrâ dah'yunãm.
segments.en:
When, O Mazda, will the nobles understand the message? When
will thou smite the filthiness of this intoxicant, through which
the Karapans evilly deceive, and the wicked lords of the lands
with purpose fell?

segments.orig:
kadâ mazdâ ashâ mat ârmaitish dà
jimat xshathrâ husheitish vâstravaitî kôi
dregvôdebîsh xrûrâish râmãm
dåñtê kêñg â vanghêush
jimat mananghô cistish.
segments.en:
When, O Mazda, shall Piety come with Right, with Dominion
the happy dwelling rich with pasture? Who are they that will make
peace with the bloodthirsty Liars? To whom will the Lore of Good
Thought come?

segments.orig:
at tôi anghen saoshyañtô dah'yunãm
ýôi xshnûm vohû mananghâ hacåñtê
shyaothanâish ashâ thwahyâ mazdâ sêñghahyâ
tôi-zî dâtâ hamaêstârô
aêshem mahyâ!
segments.en:
These shall be the deliverers [Saoshyants -JHP] of the provinces, who exert
themselves, O Good Thought in their action, O Asha, to fulfill
their duty, face to face with thy command, O Mazda. For these
are the appointed smiters of Violence.
